[[File:Imperial_Celebration_Organizer_GH.jpg|250px|thumb|An Imperial Celebration Officer]]
An '''Imperial Celebration Organizer''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] that was in charge of organizing various pro-Imperial events. One such officer was tasked with overseeing an [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] celebration in the [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] around the time after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] sold various Imperial rations, including [[Gracious Government Mix]] (which is said to be the favorite of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] himself) and [[Order 66 Cookie]]s. As he was specifically trained to root out [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] infiltrators, he will only sell the cookies to those loyal to the Empire.<ref name="SWG:ED">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Empire Day}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Celebration Organizer was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Imperial Celebration Organizer could be found near [[Empire Day Emperor's Statue|the statue of Emperor Palpatine]] on Theed, where he would sell various Empire Day related consumable items such as Gracious Government Mix and Order 66 Cookies to players who were affiliated with the Empire. The Rebel equivalent was the [[Rebel Event Organizer]].<ref name="SWG:ED" />
